title: Important moments stay in view
changes: Routine river-flow and woodland-season accounting no longer crowd out founding, reform and discovery in the Chronicle. Their full recorded facts remain available in Events; blocked work stays prominent.
State workforce now explains its released Learning patronage alternative to Urban planning. This is a presentation update; paid simulation rules are unchanged.

title: Learning or building
changes: Civilizations that complete State workforce can choose Learning patronage instead of Urban planning, even when a wildcard slot is available. Existing reform prices, commitments and government transitions still apply.

A fully paid and staffed Library, House of learning or University earns 25% more of its actual Science under patronage. Construction keeps its separate priority; receipts show the exact earned contribution. New worlds start fresh.

title: Harvest and rest in worked woodlands
changes: Lumber mills and Charcoal clearings share the finite work-lots of their exact forest tile. A fully paid, staffed season harvests one of eight lots; only a season without harvest recovers one. Continuous output now alternates with recovery after the initial stock is used.

Forest stands retain their identity while density, stumps and recorded recovery reveal local use. Recipes still need their complete inputs and residents; controllers can favor useful harvest or protected rest without assuming future recovery. This build starts fresh.
